title: GESA-UENR Academic Resource Hub
tagline: Slides, books, past questions and tutorials for your programme, level and course, all in one place.
about: The Ghana Engineering Students’ Association (GESA-UENR) represents engineering students of the University of Energy and Natural Resources, Sunyani.
mission: The Academic Committee exists to make quality study material easy to find and free to access for every engineering student.
contribute: Have slides, past questions or tutorials? Send them to the Academic Committee with the course code, lecturer and year, and we will add them.
